Market today: The tech and chip sector is under pressure, primarily driven by negative news surrounding Nvidia and its CEO, Jensen Huang. This is creating a cautious mood, especially for your concentrated book. 

Your holdings: Your portfolio is flashing red across the board. SOXL (-85.02%), MUU (-71.49%), and SPAL (-55.77%) are in severe drawdown. Given you're on margin, these deep losses in leveraged positions are extremely concerning and amplify risk. 

Watch: Keep a very close eye on Nvidia's situation and its impact on the broader chip sector. Also, monitor your stops on all leveraged positions, as decay and volatility are working against you. 

Bottom line: Your current portfolio structure, especially with margin and leveraged ETFs, demands immediate and decisive risk management.
plays: SOXL: Exit this position. An 85% loss on a leveraged ETF with an ineffective stop is an extreme risk on margin.
MUU: Review this leveraged position. A 71% loss is unsustainable; consider trimming or exiting to reduce margin exposure.
NVDD: If seeking a hedge against chip weakness, consider a small position in NVDD at entry 36.86-36.82, stop 36.6.
